question.text: CAPM required return: Rf = 7%, Rm = 13%, β = 1.2. Required return is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Re = 7 + 1.2 × (13 - 7) = 7 + 7.2 = 14.2%. The Trap: 15.6/19.6 are computation errors. Cross-Exam Context: Universal CAPM. Manager's Pro-Tip: Use rolling beta (60-month or 1-year) for current estimates; historical beta drifts over time.
